title: pricing-packaging-scratchpad-v7
content:
Quick back-of-envelope for pricing tiers + unit economics (scratchpad)

Assumptions (baseline)
- Model mix: small-gen (open-7B-style) = 60%, medium-gen (13B-ish) = 30%, large-gen (70B/opt) = 10%
- Avg request tokens: 1,200 input + 800 output = 2,000 tokens per API call (chat flow with context)
- Serving efficiency: effective tokens/sec per GPU at 8-bit quantized: small=5k t/s, medium=3k t/s, large=1k t/s (warm KV, batching)
- GPU cost (cloud equivalent amortized): small/medium/large share -> cost per GPU-hour: $2.50 (small tenants) / $5 / $15 (family-level approximation, includes infra + infra ops)
- Per-GPU token throughput per hour: small=18M t/hr, medium=10.8M t/hr, large=3.6M t/hr
- Utilization assumption for public hosted (avg across customers): 45% (peaks higher; padding for SLAs)

Raw token cost (inference infra only) per 1K tokens
- small: GPU cost/hr $2.50 -> cost per token = $2.50 / 18,000,000 = $1.39e-7 -> per 1K = $0.000139. Adjust for util (x1/0.45) -> $0.00031 per 1K
- medium: $5 / 10,800,000 = $4.63e-7 -> per 1K = $0.000463 -> util adj -> $0.00103 per 1K
- large: $15 / 3,600,000 = $4.17e-6 -> per 1K = $0.00417 -> util adj -> $0.00927 per 1K

Add overheads (network, storage, control plane, monitoring, support, margin)
- baseline multiplier: x3.5 (monitoring+network+SLA+support+amortized infra ops) -> numbers become:
  - small: $0.00109 per 1K tokens
  - medium: $0.0036 per 1K tokens
  - large: $0.0325 per 1K tokens

Include build-in margin for promotion and R&D -> list price multiplier x2 (for hosted API)
- list price per 1K tokens (hosted):
  - small: $0.0022 per 1K (round to $0.002)
  - medium: $0.0072 per 1K (round to $0.0075)
  - large: $0.065 per 1K (round to $0.07)

Check vs market comps: Open/competitors' list pricing often $0.002-$0.03 per 1K depending on model. Our mid-tier ~$0.0075 seems defensible if latency/SLA + tooling = value prop.

Embeddings pricing (quick)
- Embedding compute footprint lower per token but more memory. Assume embed throughput = 25k vectors/hr per GPU and cost/GPU-hour $5 -> cost/vector = $5/25k = $0.0002 -> per 1k vectors = $0.20 infra -> util adj 0.45 -> $0.44 -> overhead x3 -> $1.32 -> margin x2 -> $2.64 list per 1k vectors. -> Suggest rounding to $2.50 per 1k embeddings (dense, single vector).
- But we can offer bulk discount / indexing SKU for high-volume customers: $0.60–$1.00 per 1k depending on committed capacity (reserved pools).

Tier ideas (hosted API)
- Free tier: 0.5M tokens/month + 1k embeddings dev credits (for onboarding)
- Starter (pay-as-you-go): pay-per-token at list price; soft throttle, community support.
- Scale (volume discounts): 10k–10M tokens/month target customers; tiered pricing with 10% discounts at thresholds (1M/5M/10M tokens).
- Business: committed monthly minimum (reserved capacity) + 20% lower per-token (because commit) + access to per-route observability retention 30d, support SLA p2/p1 on business hours
- Enterprise: Dedicated / Private offers: per-token price ~50–70% of hosted list (because dedicated commits + negotiated infra), plus platform fee (monthly) for private control plane and stronger SLAs. Also offer burst credits and prewarming windows.

Reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go math (very approximate)
- Customer with 100M tokens/mo (avg mix = medium): infra cost approx = 100M/1k * $0.0036 = $360. With margin x2 list -> $720/mo. If they commit to 1 year reserved nodes, we can drop price to $0.004/1k -> $400/mo and capture committed revenue + lower variance.

Channel for embedding heavy customers: offer Indexing SKU where we charge per-GB indexed + search qps. This helps convert vector-heavy apps from per-call pricing to storage+query pricing and reduces per-vector list price.

Unresolved / TODOs
- Validate throughput numbers with infra team (Sofia) — current assumptions optimistic for some workloads (long sequences).
- Model mix assumption needs telemetry from hosted trials (Michael to pull last 90d model usage).
- Evaluate region premium (APAC/Eu West) for infra cost uplift (network + reserved cloud pricing).
- Run 1-week experiment: A/B pricing on new customers to test elasticity around mid-tier (0.005–0.01 per 1k).
- Decide on rounding conventions and published denominations (per 1k, per-month minimal billing unit).

Notes to self:
- Keep messaging simple: price per 1k tokens + model multipliers (e.g., small/medium/large labels) + embedding per 1k vectors. Add a 'Dedicated' and 'Reserved' slider for discounts.
- Must coordinate with legal on contract language for 'inference vs storage' billing (embeds stored for search).

Quick examples to paste into deck
- Customer A (SaaS chat): 2M tokens/mo (mix small 80%, medium 20%) -> infra cost ~ (1.6M * $0.00109 + 0.4M * $0.0036)/1k = ~$2.0 infra -> list price x2 -> ~$4/mo (this looks off, check units carefully) -> NOTE: re-check arithmetic before slide.
- Customer B (marketplace): 50M embeddings/month -> at list $2.5/1k -> $125,000/mo -> clearly need index SKU/reserved to be viable.

End of scratchpad. Keep iterative.

[handwritten style notes: put final numbers into spreadsheet after infra validation; aim for parity+value for mid-market; preserve headroom for discounts and partner margins.]
